pet_notes: Original anime-inspired young woman doctoral researcher, inspired by the scholarly presence of Iroha Sakayori without directly reproducing copyrighted character design. Long dark charcoal hair with a subtle violet sheen, intelligent amber-violet eyes, calm sharp expression with a hint of sleep-deprived warmth, oversized clean white research lab coat over muted plum sweater and dark skirt or trousers, simple closed shoes, small attached ID-card shape with no readable text. Compact chibi whole-body silhouette, researcher identity must read clearly at pet size. Keep the lab coat, hairstyle, face, palette, and proportions identical across all animation states.
